description: Checklist, color and time of day fields in an SvGrid Base, in Svelte 5. A checklist cell shows how many items are done and opens an editor to tick, add, rename, reorder and delete them; a color cell shows a swatch and hex code; a time of day is stored as HH:MM and typed as 9:30 am, 14:05 or 2pm.
keywords: svelte grid time picker 12 hour 24 hour

faq.question: How is a checklist stored?
faq.answer: As an array of items, each { id, text, done }, in the order they show. A copy writes them as text, "[x] Done item [ ] Open item", and a paste or a CSV import reads that back. It sorts by the share of items done and filters by is complete, is not complete, % done or an item's text.

faq.question: Which colors can be pasted into a color field?
faq.answer: #rgb, #rrggbb, rgb(r, g, b) and common CSS names such as red, navy or teal. The value is stored as lower case #rrggbb. Text that is not one of those (a name not on the list, hsl(), a color with alpha) leaves the cell as it was.

faq.question: Why is a time of day stored as text and not as seconds?
faq.answer: HH:MM on a 24-hour clock reads the same in JSON, a CSV and a SQL time column, sorts in time order as plain text, and cannot be mistaken for a duration, which the base stores as seconds. The field's 12 or 24 hour setting only changes what the cell shows.

faq.question: Which license does it need?
faq.answer: SvGrid Base is part of the Suite edition of @svgrid/enterprise. Without a key it runs with a watermark, so it can be evaluated as is.
